thesis: Mohnish Pabrai argues that successful ventures often require embracing uncertainty and acting without complete data, citing his experience of starting Dukshana without knowing how to find talented students. He illustrates this by describing how he initially copied Anand Kumar's Super 30 model despite lacking the specific expertise to recruit students, eventually solving that problem by hiring a consultant who discovered a partnership with the Navodaya Vidyalaya system.
